title: Income Annuities Commutation Discount Rate: Floor for Seasoned Contracts and Cap for Recent Ones
content:
The annual rate at which the remaining certain installments of an Ashgrove Income Annuities period-certain contract are discounted for a commutation is held within a floor or a cap according to how long the contract has been in force — the whole months from the issue date to the election:

- **In force 120 months or more**, and the contract's pricing interest rate plus the commutation discount spread is below the rate floor: the annual discount rate is the rate floor, **5.5% (0.0550)**.
- **In force fewer than 120 months**, and the pricing interest rate plus the spread is above the rate cap: the annual discount rate is the rate cap, **9% (0.0900)**.
- In any other combination neither the floor nor the cap applies.

### Truth table

| Months in force | Pricing rate plus spread | Annual discount rate |
|---|---|---|
| 120 or more | Below 5.5% | 5.5% |
| 120 or more | 5.5% or more | Neither applies |
| Fewer than 120 | Above 9% | 9% |
| Fewer than 120 | 9% or less | Neither applies |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical).** In force 120 months, pricing rate plus spread 4.75%: 5.5%. In force 119 months, same 4.75%: neither applies. In force 60 months, pricing rate plus spread 9.25%: 9%. In force 120 months, 9.25%: neither applies. Exactly 5.5% or exactly 9% is neither below the floor nor above the cap.
